definition: The corpus's own considered convention: an honest judgment, labelled as one, where no source settles the figure. The ridge of a Georgian hipped roof at a quarter to a half of the building's length is one.
basis: schema/kit.schema.json, on a figure's kind: "editorial: our considered convention." VISION.md: "Every number carries a source or is explicitly labelled as an editorial judgment." kits/georgian-colonial-american.kit.json roof_form.hip_ridge_length_ratio.note: "Ridge length as a fraction of the building length on a hipped roof. Below a quarter the roof reads pyramidal; above a half the hips read as clipped gables."
